summary: The first real-U1 read-only attempt against the RC2 packages exited 1 and aborted before the harness wrote hardware.json, so no total exists for it. This file records what the console showed, not a result.

failures.check: The printer's own bed size was used in the bed check
failures.observed: 1 object(s) fall outside this printer's 270 × 270 mm printable area
failures.root_cause: stale harness expectation: Studio names the profile's printable area, never the printer's reported axis travel (271 × 335 × 281 mm), by design

failures.check: The provider supplies the weight the machine cannot know (spoolman)
failures.root_cause: synthetic seed had no consumption record, so the weight is correctly labelled derived, not tracked

failures.check: The provider supplies the weight the machine cannot know (bambuddy)
failures.root_cause: synthetic seed had no weighing record, so the weight is correctly labelled derived, not tracked

aborted_at.step: nozzle confirmation in the Settings UI
aborted_at.error: TimeoutError waiting for the 'Toolhead 1' table row
aborted_at.root_cause: stale harness flow: the printer address is only saved on Save/Enter and the Nozzles card appears only for a saved address; the harness typed the address without saving it

incomplete_coverage: The nozzle confirmation checks and everything after them did not run in this attempt.
note: All three root causes were in verification tooling, not in the shipped product. See attempt 2 in hardware-1.7.0.json and the harness identity in TRUST_STATUS.md. The account used for this attempt was consumed and is never reused.
